discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 205eeaa55b. A sent suggestion now records the chat's run count (and its attachments) at send time, and Undo looks for its message only among turns after that point, so an earlier copy of the same prompt is never the match. Matching also reads past the `[attached N files]` label, so a send that carried files is found and undone. A take-back that's still queued puts the files back on the composer. The label lives in `lib/attached-files-label.ts`, so adding it and stripping it can't drift apart.
Fixed in 229051e. normalizeTerminalCwd now keeps the separator for filesystem roots, so / stays / and C:\ stays C:\ instead of collapsing to ~ or C:.

Fixed in 202642e: parseStatus now keeps the original path on R/C records (originalPath on the file entry). The webview includes it in unstage actions (unstagePaths helper, used for row, group, and breadcrumb unstage) and passes it to get_git_file_diff so a staged rename reads HEAD at the old path. Covered by a real-repo test that git mv's a file, checks the diff shows the old contents, unstages both paths, and verifies the old path is no longer staged as a deletion.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fixed in 24f543400: the working side of a submodule now reads like git diff: its checked-out HEAD plus '-dirty' when it has uncommitted changes, so an edited-but-uncommitted submodule previews as 'Subproject commit <sha>' -> 'Subproject commit <sha>-dirty' instead of 'No textual changes'. It also checks the path is the submodule's own repository root first, so an uninitialized submodule can't report the superproject's HEAD. Covered in the real-submodule test.

Valid, fixed. A link whose target is a directory already on the current copy chain, or an ancestor of one (`.`, `..`, a sibling that links back), is now skipped and listed in `skippedPaths` instead of being expanded again, and the number of linked-directory expansions is capped (`MAX_LINK_EXPANSIONS`). Covered by "skips links that loop back into a directory being copied": twenty links to `.` plus one to `..` finish in well under a second with only the real content copied.
Fixed in d85a07cc1. With Cloud Only on, the whole history is listed and filtered first; offset, limit and hasMore apply to the filtered records.
